flags.message: The September 16 snapshot records an August 26 opposition and September 4 reply, but the July 17 document manifest provisions only the petition and questions presented. The petition is marked truncated. The exact opposition-PDF web retrieval failed. Forecast proceeds using the available petition and its lower-court opinion appendix, without attributing arguments to the unread BIO or reply. Later-filed adversarial briefing would improve input balance.
